_comment: Few-shot examples encoding the K-VERSATION editorial style: sparse, intentional visuals for major events, named people/places, maps, documents, battles, emotional beats and topic transitions. Generic connective narration is deliberately NOT selected.
style_notes: A visual appears only when it adds information the words cannot: a face, a place, a document, a map, a scale.
Prefer one strong image per beat over several weak ones.
Maps at geographic transitions, portraits at first mention of a key person, documents when a text/treaty/letter is quoted.
Battles and major events get the single most iconic image, not a montage.
Emotional beats may use an evocative period photograph; abstract reflection stays on black.
